verdict_reason: This second gate factory repeats buildGate's metadata stamping with a different admits signature, and the internals docs do not mention it.

todos.issue: buildAnyCandidateGate is a second gate factory beside internals/build-gate.js, and it repeats that factory's metadata stamping: gateType, obligationId and the Object.defineProperty getter for 'values' (lines 17-26 copy build-gate.js lines 54-63). Its admits callback also takes a different shape, (candidate, list), where buildGate's takes (value) and closes over currentValues. And the docs were not updated for it: obligations/README.md line 185 still lists build-gate, run-gate and derive-union as the only internals, and the header of helper-internals.js (line 4) still names anyAllowListed as the caller of readGate.
todos.fix: Must: one function stamps gate metadata (gateType, obligationId, lazy values) for both factories. admits has one signature across both factories. README.md and helper-internals.js name buildAnyCandidateGate where they list the internals and their callers. One way: extract a stampGateMetadata(gate, { gateType, gateObligation, currentValues, ...extra }) used by both buildGate and buildAnyCandidateGate, pass admits as (value) => ... closing over currentValues as buildGate does, and update the README line and the helper-internals.js header.
